review.$comment: INVERTED review stack (Fable pick 2026-07-05, agent a6d340fec96cbd119). Review is read-heavy, so put the CHEAP cross-model lens first (always-on, diff-scoped) and demote Opus to a capped, diff-only, conditional 2nd pass. Deterministic gates (build/test/lint) run BEFORE any review token; a failing gate bounces to implement with the error text, zero review spend. Reviewers are ALWAYS diff-scoped — never re-read the repo (biggest token save).

primary.$comment: First lens — cheap non-Anthropic model, always-on. Cross-model lens per commenters (Gemini/GPT/Grok each catch 1-2 extra bugs). Start with one Gemini lens; add GPT/Grok later if worth it.

escalation.$comment: Second pass — Opus HIGH, diff-only, triggered ONLY when the primary lens flags OR a deterministic gate fails. Loop capped at 2. NEVER off-Anthropic.
